name: Lab: an own Codex run's commands never read obid's vault, but in Bypass, on a real Linux obid
description: LANES-27 (the owner's "Merge, add guard after", 2026-11-20) against the real obid this checkout builds and the real codex-cli 0.163.0 sandbox, on an isolated Ubuntu 24.04 machine. The owner's Codex jobs in Ask, Sandbox and Bypass run on Codex's stand-in, which keeps the exact -c settings obid started it with; each thread's settings are then replayed into the real `codex sandbox` with its profile, reading a canary file in obid's vault folder. Ask (:read-only) and Sandbox (:workspace) are refused; Bypass (:danger-full-access, no sandbox) reads it, as the contract says. Red on #2683's code: there Ask's and Sandbox's profiles were the bare built-ins, which read it. No model call, no login. Skipped without OrbStack.

inputs.command: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; command -v python3 >/dev/null || sudo -E apt-get install -y -qq python3 >/dev/null; A=$(uname -m); mkdir -p ~/bin && curl -fsSL -o /tmp/codex.tgz "https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/download/rust-v0.163.0/codex-$A-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz" && tar xzf /tmp/codex.tgz -C /tmp && install -m 755 "/tmp/codex-$A-unknown-linux-musl" ~/bin/codex && mkdir -p /tmp/cx-scratch && ~/bin/codex --version

for id in ${state.ask-job.body.id} ${state.sandbox-job.body.id} ${state.bypass-job.body.id}; do for i in $(seq 1 120); do j=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat /home/oby/.oby/home/api-token)" http://127.0.0.1:7811/v1/jobs/$id); case "$j" in *'"status":"done"'*|*'"status":"failed"'*|*'"status":"interrupted"'*) break;; esac; sleep 1; done; case "$j" in *'"status":"done"'*) echo "$id done";; *) echo "$id not done: $j";; esac; done

set -u
canary=/home/oby/.oby/home/vault/lab-canary
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$canary")" && printf 'VAULT-CANARY' > "$canary"
printf 'control: '; cat "$canary"; echo
for t in /home/oby/.oby/home/accounts/codex/threads/*.json; do
python3 - "$t" <<'PY' > /tmp/replay.sh
import json, sys, shlex
t = json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
keep = [s for s in t.get("settings", []) if s.split("=")[0] in ("approval_policy", "default_permissions") or s.startswith("permissions.")]
profile = t.get("permissions")
args = ["/home/oby/bin/codex"]
for s in keep:
    args += ["-c", s]
args += ["sandbox", "-P", profile, "-C", "/home/oby/.oby/home/worktrees", "--", "cat", "/home/oby/.oby/home/vault/lab-canary"]
base = next((s.split("=", 1)[1].strip('"') for s in keep if s.startswith("permissions.oby.extends=")), profile)
print("printf '%s: ' " + shlex.quote(base))
print(" ".join(shlex.quote(a) for a in args) + " >/tmp/out 2>&1 && echo read || echo \"refused ($(head -c 120 /tmp/out | tr \"\\n\" \" \"))\"")
PY
CODEX_HOME=/tmp/cx-scratch bash /tmp/replay.sh
done
